reviewer: Codex in the current user-authorized study chat

findings.8002.tif: 102 labeled pixels form a left-edge sliver (bbox y223..248 x0..7); the detector has no TP. Edge context limits interpretation.
findings.3173.tif: Only two foreground pixels, both at x255 y120..121. These cannot establish a visually recoverable semantic building change. Keep the original labels and disclose the boundary limitation.
findings.9371.tif: The model detects part of the labeled change and misses the roadside label region; another conspicuous roof difference receives FP. Whether this reflects roof-only appearance change, footprint label policy or a missing annotation is unresolved.
findings.3270.tif: Most labeled left-edge pixels are detected, with substantial predictions on unlabeled roofs. Visual difference alone does not prove label error.
findings.empty_examples: Four preselected forest/field/mixed scene empty tiles produce no positive predictions. This selection does not estimate population FPR.

conclusion: No gross A/B/mask dimensional misalignment observed in the eight panels; small/boundary ambiguity and semantic roof/footprint issues remain. Proceed with matched ordinary augmentation without relabeling, pruning, changing severity, sampling, threshold or loss. This is not a dataset-wide label acceptance.
